The first name of '''Bili''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Bili Adarra]] - a young man from the [[Two Rivers]] and distant cousin of [[Perrin Aybara]].
*[[Bili al'Dai]] - a young man from the Two Rivers, now deceased from a [[Trolloc]] attack.
*[[Bili Congar]] - an elderly man from the Two Rivers who once named the [[Dark One]].
*[[Bili Mandair]] - a boy born during the [[Aiel War]].
*[[Bili (bouncer)|Bili]] - a bouncer at an inn called [[Easing the Badger]] in [[Illian]].
*Bili - Titular character from ''[[Bili Under the Hill]]'', a children's story about a boy who finds gold and answers.
